name: megascenes-fathers-day-card
description: Design Father's Day cards for your dad, your grandpa or any father you love, with his name, your message and your signature in the design.

interface.longDescription:
Give who the card is for, the main line, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: classic navy and wood, vintage, mountains and fishing, a funny cartoon, minimal. You get a Father's Day card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For dads, grandpas, stepdads and every father you want to thank on Father's Day.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set his name, your message and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A classic navy and wood Father's Day card for Dad, signed Love, Mia
A funny cartoon Father's Day card that says Thanks for all the dad jokes
A vintage card with mountains for Grandpa Joe: Happy Father's Day 2027

positive.prompt: A classic navy and wood Father's Day card for Dad, signed Love, Mia. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Father's Day card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A funny cartoon Father's Day card that says Thanks for all the dad jokes. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a Father's Day card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Father's Day card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A Father's Day card with a lake and a fishing rod, square, with the words Thanks for all the lessons, Dad. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my Father's Day card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my Father's Day card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
